items.difficulty_reason: 83-line proof fully executed: equivalence of the two claims definitional; the case x in U via the intersected chain; the case x not in U via the flat morphism from the local ring, quasi-compact replacement, scheme-theoretic image commuting with flat base change (named lemma), density of the pullback, the Jacobson property of the punctured spectrum (named lemma), a closed point z with a three-property closure analysis (bijection of irreducible closed subsets under the flat pullback, written out), a Jacobson closed point u in U cap Z with proper inclusion, and the catenary refinement of the chain X > Z > {x} to length d+1 giving a strictly decreasing chain in U of length d+1. No omissions.
